name: wema-first-is-a-habit
description: 30-second spec spot for Wema Bank, rendered frame-by-frame from one function of time, in 16:9, 1:1 and 9:16.

scripts.render: node render.js --format 16x9 && node render.js --format 9x16 && node render.js --format 1x1
scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run render
